projects.title: Bridge Vet: Veterinary Clinic Platform
projects.impact: Vets spend less time on paperwork: SOAP notes, medication lists and follow-ups are drafted by AI in the background after each appointment.
description: Managed a development team to deliver an end-to-end clinic management system; built a scalable FastAPI, Redis and Celery backend for asynchronous AI SOAP note generation, medication extraction and appointment follow-ups.
Developed a custom RAG-based clinical assistant for dosage calculations, evaluated retrieval accuracy with Langfuse, and built OCR pipelines that automate inventory tracking.

projects.title: eQRA-AI: Islamic AI Assistant Mobile App
projects.impact: App users get sourced answers on fatwas and duas from an assistant that remembers their past conversations and sends timely notifications.
description: Built the backend for an Islamic AI assistant, deploying dual RAG chatbots for precise fatwa and dua retrieval, with Mem0-powered long-term conversational memory.
Engineered an event-driven notification system using AWS EventBridge, SNS and Lambda to send real-time push notifications through FCM.

Scaled deployments on DigitalOcean App Platform with Redis and Celery on droplets, and self-hosted Grafana Loki for log aggregation. Prototyped a LangGraph multi-tool agent that routes questions between live web search and Qdrant.

projects.title: Yani: AI Assistant for Chartered Accountants
projects.impact: Accountants check documents against regulations and ask questions of their data in plain English instead of writing SQL.
description: Built a RAG chatbot for chartered accountants, alongside a document compliance workflow that checks text against regulatory frameworks to map clauses and flag non-compliance.
Implemented database chat with Vanna.ai trained on complex schemas, reaching 92% accuracy in natural language to SQL.
Developed an Autogen multi-agent system that runs exploratory data analysis and generates charts from the extracted SQL data.

projects.title: Fine-Tuning Whisper for Quranic Arabic
projects.impact: More accurate transcription of Quran recitation, including the diacritics that general-purpose speech models get wrong.
description: Built a fine-tuning pipeline for OpenAI's Whisper on 10,000+ Quranic Tarteel audio samples to improve specialized Arabic speech-to-text and phonetic accuracy.
Achieved a 90% improvement in Harakat (diacritic) recognition and cut word error rate by 30–40% against the base model.
